text:
pagerduty-bot: PagerDuty alert - GPU pool 'inference-eu-west' has reached autoscaler max (maxNodes=48). Queue depth growing, multiple clients experiencing throttling. Pager assigned to @alyssa_oncall. Link: https://ops.internal/alerts/2150001234 :rotating_light:
alyssa_oncall: On it. Seeing queue growth -> 2.9k pending, 5xx rate up to 8% on /v1/generate in eu-west, tail latency > 2.5s. Confirmed autoscaler refused further scale (scaler logs show 'max nodes reached'). Trying to gather spike cause.
jamie_sre: Noted. Is this hitting Dedicated pools or Hosted?
mike_runtime: It's Hosted (shared inference pool). Runtime telemetry shows sustained concurrency increase from a customer load test starting ~10:03 UTC. We have KV-cache hit rates normal. Batching can't keep up because number of new streams increased.
al yssa_oncall: typo? (meant alyssa_oncall)
alyssa_oncall: Correction: "alyssa_oncall". @lina_infra can we do an emergency manual bump to maxNodes=56? We have capacity in the AWS quota but autoscaler config caps at 48. Need approval and a patch to HPA/ClusterAutoscaler limits.
lina_infra: We can open a temporary bump. Two paths: 1) update cluster-autoscaler max nodes via k8s config (quick but risk autoscaler churn), 2) spin a separate emergency pool (longer). I recommend #1 for speed. I need an approver from product/security for customer-impact risk (cost/overprovisioning).
tori_prod: From product — OK to increase for 1 hour to reduce customer-facing errors. Track cost and rollback once stable.
kevin_support: FYI affected customers: two enterprise tenants (acme-inc, bayanalytics) reported degraded responses. CS has informed acme-inc & started a support ticket.
jamie_sre: Quick checklist: - ensure scale bump doesn't hit cloud quota (I verified region quota has spare GPUs) - update autoscaler maxNodes (k8s) - watch per-route 5xx and queue depth - set rollback timer 60m - annotate incident and notify customers.
mike_runtime: Commands to patch (tested in staging):
```
kubectl -n kube-system patch deployment cluster-autoscaler --patch '{"spec":{"template":{"spec":{"containers":[{"name":"cluster-autoscaler","args":["--nodes=4:56:gpu-pool-inference"]}]}}}}'
```
al yssa_oncall: I'll coordinate the change. @lina_infra please perform the patch and announce when done. Jamie, please monitor. Mike, have the rollback runbook ready.
lina_infra: Applying patch now (will run kube patch and verify nodes spin). Running in 2 mins.
--- 2150001245 (system): lina_infra started a deploy: cluster-autoscaler patch
lina_infra: patch applied. CA args now include --nodes=4:56:gpu-pool-inference. Triggering scale.
--- 2150001252 (system): AWS ASG scaling activity detected: launching 6 g4dn.xlarge-like nodes (estimated)
jamie_sre: Watching. Queue depth dropping: 2.9k -> 1.6k -> 700 in the last 4m. 5xx rate falling: 8% -> 2.1% -> 0.6%. Latency 95p coming down.
mike_runtime: Seeing new nodes join, runtime assigned pods across new nodes. No pod crashloop. KV cache priming causing slight CPU spike but expected.
kevin_support: Support update: acme-inc reported improvement, their requests are succeeding again. Keeping ticket open until stable.
alyssa_oncall: Good. We agreed on temporary +8 nodes (48->56) for 60 minutes. Lina, please annotate the autoscaler change and add a reminder tag to revert at +60m.
lina_infra: Added annotation: "temp-bump:2150001234" and created a scheduled rollback job for 60m. Job will remove the extra nodes by restoring CA args to 48 max.
mike_runtime: Setting up additional telemetry alarms to auto-alert if 5xx returns >1% for 10m. Also creating a quick grafana panel link: https://grafana.internal/d/xxx/gpu-pool-inference
jamie_sre: Running light load verification and synthetic requests to ensure stability. All green.
--- 2150001280 (system): rollback-job scheduled for 60 minutes from patch time
alyssa_oncall: Thanks team. Post-incident actions: - owner: jamie_sre to write blameless postmortem - engineering to evaluate autoscaler policy to allow short emergency burst or dynamic override - product to coordinate with customers for a little slack window for planned load tests - infra to add safety checks to prevent runaway cost. I'll create the incident issue and assign.
tori_prod: I'll follow up with customers and propose scheduling for non-peak load test windows.
jamie_sre: Drafting postmortem now, will include root cause (unscheduled customer load test + autoscaler hard cap), mitigation (temp bump + rollback), and long-term fix proposals (dynamic emergency headroom, more conservative per-customer rate limits).
--- 2150001290 (system): autoscaler rollback job executed? (placeholder; final exec will be logged in follow-up thread)
alyssa_oncall: Leaving final note: Metrics normalized, queue < 50, 5xx ~0.1%. Closing paging for now. Incident ticket: INC-2150001234. Will reopen if regressions. :white_check_mark:
